BUILDPLAN.md T-26 (M1).

The static fallback: `mode: "static"` in the wall (no socket, the phase held locally, the question baked in), the `Space`/`←`/`→`/`Esc` driver, and a one-file build with fonts and tokens inlined that makes no network request; the same fixture renders identically in both modes; and the **host sheet** function, a question record to plain text, that T-20 calls beside the build (`SPEC.md` §12, D-21, D-24)

Criteria: AC-102, AC-97, AC-99
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-02, T-05
BUILDPLAN notes: Not part of HC-0's trigger, but the client opens the file offline at HC-0 and reads the sheet against it. Edits `web/wall/`; consumes `web/shared/`

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: DISPATCHED 2026-09-26 17:1x by the Orchestrator (wave 9, inline-full, press-ahead). surface:27 in pane:1. Worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/static-fallback, branch ai-c11-cc/static-fallback off origin/ai-c11-cc/wall @ 91bc59950c293e3f844a5bad6af22569ff1f0bfa (PQ-7, PR #21, at review). Actor agent:delegator-pq12. Boot prompt in <worktree>/.claude/boot-prompt.md (gen-wave9.py). PR against ai-c11-cc/wall until #21 merges, then retargeted to main by the Orchestrator. The wall branch is frozen (fast-forward only).
READY PQ-12 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/static-fallback HEAD 91bc59950c293e3f844a5bad6af22569ff1f0bfa BASE 91bc59950c293e3f844a5bad6af22569ff1f0bfa MODE active

ORCHESTRATOR: your parent #21 (the wall) merged to main at ed32240 and GitHub deleted ai-c11-cc/wall. Run: git branch --unset-upstream; git fetch origin; git merge origin/main (no rebase — your branch is not pushed yet, so a rebase would also be fine, but merge keeps it simple). Base your PR on main and drop the 'Based on #21' line. origin/main now holds the wiring (#20) and the twin (#19) too.

PAUSED PQ-12 (client usage limit). Status in_planning. Branch fast-forwarded to origin/main @ ed322404a92bcca78ddd84d82022feb32905a801, upstream unset; PR will target main without the 'Based on #21' line. Plan written to the plan file. The plan-review subagent was stopped before it reported, so the review has to be run again on resume. No code written or committed yet. Note for the Orchestrator: nothing in room/ or pipeline/ puts the options in the date's slot order (slot_for_day has no caller), so both the room and this fallback show bank order. The fallback follows whatever order it is given; T-20 must arrange the question before calling it.

ORCHESTRATOR 19:0x: usage limit reset. RESUME from your PAUSED comment: re-run the plan review, record the resolutions, move to planned, then implement. Your finding (no caller of slot_for_day arranges options into the date's order) is T-20's job — PQ-4's deviation (2) already put it on PQ-25; the fallback renders options in the order it is given, as you planned. #22 host phone and #23 buzzer are still landing; origin/main is ed32240 (twin, wiring, wall) and will move twice more — merge it again before your first push.

BLOCKED PQ-12 on commit signing. Code is written and green (pipeline 603, web 140, room all pass with --no-fail-fast outside the sandbox) and the c11-browser test-full run is done. The first commit is staged (web/wall/wall.js, web/wall/qr.js); the rest are uncommitted in the worktree. Every signed commit fails. Bypassed git commit: '1Password: failed to fill whole buffer', twice. The client-approved fallback (git -c gpg.ssh.program=ssh-keygen, SSH_AUTH_SOCK = the 1Password agent socket; ssh-add -l lists 'SSH Key (ED25519)') fails with 'communication with agent failed'. git fetch also failed at 'sign_and_send_pubkey: signing failed ... communication with agent failed', so the 1Password agent is refusing all signing right now. Signing is not disabled or bypassed. Needs: unlock 1Password, or approve its SSH-agent prompt, then tell me to retry. Also for the Orchestrator: room/src/rooms.rs's dev Urls.home is '/home', but SPEC §13 names take-it-home '/last'; the fallback defaults to https://popquiz.rustnyc.org/last.
UNBLOCKED PQ-12: 1Password unlocked by the client; five signed commits landed (f2614f5..5bb5538). Continuing: merge origin/main, code review, push, PR.
